# Instattoosionalized Tattoos and Piercings

> Tattoo studio and body piercing shop at 1852 Main St, Northampton, PA. Call (610) 440-2700.

## About

Instattoosionalized Tattoos and Piercings is a tattoo and body piercing studio on Main Street in Northampton, Pennsylvania. Three artists work at the shop: Lex, Liv, and Dawlface. Booking starts with a request sent through the website; the shop confirms each appointment itself. The shop's deposit is $40 and holds your spot.

## Contact

- Phone: (610) 440-2700
- Address: 1852 Main St, Northampton, PA
- Website: https://instattoosionalized.net/
